doc: Allocates a fixed-size (0x100) object via func_8004B404, forwarding this function's own a1-a3 straight through unused by itself (zero setup instructions -- strong evidence func_8004DC14's real signature does carry those extra params, just to relay them). If allocation fails, returns NULL. Otherwise formats/parses a0 (as a format string) plus a1 into the new object via func_8004DA74; on failure frees it via func_8004B1A4 and returns NULL (obj reset to 0, shared return path with the allocation-failure case). On success, if func_8004B4DC's result on the object is below 0x16 returns the object as-is; otherwise also echoes a0 via puts() before returning the object.
